Oscar: Heads-up: staging run showed a huge spike when runtime.flags.refresh_ttl_ms became 0 via console preview. p95 for config-service doubled and CPU spiked. Can we block this from prod?
Renee: Can you paste repro + logs? Which clients are refetching?
Oscar: Repro: preview -> publish -> invalidation broadcast -> clients call /v1/configs/fetch immediately. Logs: ```2026-06-02T11:22:01Z config-service INFO publish change runtime.flags.refresh_ttl_ms=0 by renee.console
2026-06-02T11:22:01Z edge-proxy WARN cache miss key=runtime.flags.refresh host=svc-app-42
2026-06-02T11:22:02Z config-service WARN fetch qps spike=3800 baseline=900 p95=380ms cpu=78%```
config-bot: Alert created for change ch-0c9d. Active hosts=1,180, baseline qps ~106.
Pat: TTL=0 was originally used by a few safety checks to force re-eval. We need owner signoff before changing semantics.
Anya: Short-term mitigations: (1) block console publish that sets TTL to 0 for prod (with an override workflow), (2) add preview preflight estimator that predicts refetch qps from active_host_count and ttl delta, (3) bump telemetry for config_fetch to 100% for 10min and tag events with change-id.
Renee: Also add client jitter: randomized 0-2500ms on invalidation fetch, exponential backoff on errors. Server-side: soft rate-limit per-token and support "stale-ok" header for 1s to let clients stagger.
Oscar: Preflight inputs: change-id, scope, current_ttl, new_ttl, active_host_count. Output: estimated_qps, risk_level, suggested_mitigation. If estimated_qps delta > 500 we mark high-risk and block publish until approval.
Pat: Agree. I'll DM owners and open an approval ticket. Also add a tiny dashboard card with change-id, est/obs qps, p95, error-rate.
Renee: I'll ship console validation to block TTL==0 for prod and the runtime hotpatch to coerce TTL<1000ms to 1000ms for 30m. Will request +1 from SRE.
config-bot: Change ch-0c9d paused by platform-admin.
Anya: I'll wire a mock estimator in preview-api so console shows risk before publish. Also will add telemetry tagging work.
Oscar: Quick action list: 1) pause change ch-0c9d (done) 2) console block TTL==0 for prod (Renee) 3) runtime min-ttl hotpatch (Renee) 4) preview estimator (Anya) 5) telemetry tag + dash (Pat) 6) RFC to decide TTL=0 semantics (owners). Reconvene in 30m.
